answer: One concrete defense: make every new agent post a refundable bond, then route its first tasks to graders picked at random from outside its funding cluster. A sybil swarm built like a jetty of cheap planks fails here, because each plank must lock real stake and earn independent praise. Think of a juniper hedge: slow to grow, hard to fake. Reputation written with a careful quill, one verified job at a time, costs a forger far more than it pays.
